facts.text: Frameworks for judging simulation trustworthiness differ in vocabulary but share a structure: define intended use, identify wrong-decision risk, build verification and validation evidence, characterize uncertainty, determine applicability, obtain independent or regulatory review, and constrain decisions to the demonstrated validity domain.
facts.quote: The frameworks differ in vocabulary, but they share one structure:

facts.text: The simulation credibility workflow begins by defining the safety decision and context of use.
facts.quote: Define the safety decision and context of use

facts.text: The simulation credibility workflow rates model risk as influence multiplied by consequence.
facts.quote: Rate model risk: influence x consequence

facts.text: The simulation credibility workflow sets credibility goals and acceptance criteria in advance.
facts.quote: Set credibility goals and acceptance criteria in advance

facts.text: The simulation credibility workflow verifies both code and solution.
The simulation credibility workflow validates models against independent physical data.
The simulation credibility workflow quantifies uncertainty and sensitivity.
The simulation credibility workflow declares the model's validity envelope before independent review.
facts.quote:
G[Declare the validity envelope]
    G --> H[Independent review]

facts.text: Following independent review, the simulation credibility workflow constrains the decision to the declared validity envelope, with caveats.
facts.quote: H --> I[Decision constrained to the envelope, with caveats]
